name: Klaviyo
label: Klaviyo API revision 2026-07-15 — profiles, lists, events, campaigns
description: Official Klaviyo REST JSON:API at https://a.klaviyo.com. Auth Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key {private_api_key}. Every call sends header revision (config default 2026-07-15). Profile/event/campaign writes accept purpose fields and nest them into data.attributes via bodyMap. Docs: https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. JSON:API writes use data. Do not put private_api_key here. Example: {"operation":"profile.get","profile_id":"01ABC"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verbs including trigger.listen.

schema.label: data
schema.description: JSON:API document escape hatch. Profile/event/campaign writes merge purpose fields into data. list.addProfiles / list.removeProfiles: one {type,id} object merged into data[0]. catalog.item.upsert: official catalog-item-bulk-create-job document; purpose fields merge into items.data[0].attributes.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Profile email. profile.* → data.attributes.email; event.create → data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.email. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: phone_number
schema.description: E.164 phone. Same nesting as email. Example: +15551234567.

schema.label: external_id
schema.description: Profile external_id (profile writes → data.attributes.external_id) or catalog.item.upsert item external_id → data.attributes.items.data[0].attributes.external_id.

schema.label: first_name
schema.description: Profile first name. Wired to data.attributes.first_name on profile writes.

schema.label: last_name
schema.description: Profile last name. Wired to data.attributes.last_name on profile writes.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: Custom profile properties (profile.*) or event properties (event.create).

schema.label: profile_id
schema.description: Profile id. Path for profile.get/update; data.id on profile.upsert; event.create profile relationship id; list.addProfiles / list.removeProfiles → data[0].id.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Klaviyo filter for profile.search, campaign.list, template.list. Example: equals(email,"ada@example.com").

schema.label: page_cursor
schema.description: page[cursor] from a previous list response. profile.search, campaign.list, template.list.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: page[size] for profile.search. Positive integer, typical max 100.

schema.label: list_id
schema.description: List id for list.get / list.addProfiles / list.removeProfiles. Example: Y6nRLr.

schema.label: campaign_id
schema.description: Campaign id. Path for campaign.get; data.id for campaign.send (type campaign-send-job).

schema.label: segment_id
schema.description: Segment id for segment.get.

schema.label: type
schema.description: JSON:API resource type. profile.* → data.type (profile); event.create → event; campaign.send → campaign-send-job; list.add/removeProfiles → data[0].type (profile); catalog.item.upsert → data.type (catalog-item-bulk-create-job). Example: profile.

schema.label: organization
schema.description: Profile organization. Wired to data.attributes.organization on profile writes.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Profile title (profile writes) or catalog.item.upsert item title → data.attributes.items.data[0].attributes.title.

schema.label: image
schema.description: Profile image URL. Wired to data.attributes.image on profile writes.

schema.label: location
schema.description: Profile location object {address1, city, region, zip, country}. Wired to data.attributes.location on profile writes.

schema.label: metric_name
schema.description: Event metric name for event.create. Wired to data.attributes.metric.data.attributes.name. Example: Viewed Product.

schema.label: time
schema.description: ISO-8601 event timestamp for event.create. Wired to data.attributes.time. Example: 2026-10-31T12:00:00Z.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Numeric value for event.create (e.g. order total). Wired to data.attributes.value.

schema.label: unique_id
schema.description: Idempotency id for event.create. Wired to data.attributes.unique_id. Example: a UUID v4.

schema.label: revision
schema.description: Klaviyo revision header YYYY-MM-DD. Required by every call. Default from config (2026-07-15). Example: 2026-07-15.

schema.label: description
schema.description: catalog.item.upsert item description. Wired to data.attributes.items.data[0].attributes.description.

schema.label: url
schema.description: catalog.item.upsert item URL. Wired to data.attributes.items.data[0].attributes.url.

schema.label: image_full_url
schema.description: catalog.item.upsert image URL. Wired to data.attributes.items.data[0].attributes.image_full_url.

schema.label: price
schema.description: catalog.item.upsert price. Wired to data.attributes.items.data[0].attributes.price.

schema.label: published
schema.description: catalog.item.upsert published flag. Wired to data.attributes.items.data[0].attributes.published.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Do not log emails, phones, or secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT Klaviyo verbs.

configurationParameters.label: Private API key
configurationParameters.description: Klaviyo private key pk_… (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key {key}. Never log or place on INPUT. Engine must also send revision: 2026-07-15.

configurationParameters.label: API revision
